# Broadcast rules

The demo window is 87:00–92:00 of synthetic match 9000001. Transport cannot leave it.

Numbers come from `broadcast/facts.py` and `broadcast/data/facts.json`. Do not invent a score, an expected-goals figure, a clock, or a player name in copy or in the UI.

On-screen clubs are Arsesnail and Mancheater City, the names in the event file. Do not write Arsenal, Manchester, Man City, or a competition name.

Player positions, speed, and distance covered are reconstructed. The pitch badge and the player card say so.

No crests, no competition marks, and no StatsBomb logo. Text attribution only.

Shots shorter than 0.2 seconds are close range and have no shot speed. Andrew Hornsey at 87:09 is an Arsesnail miss and is not part of Mancheater City's push.
